description.p: Apple Passwords reads your iCloud Keychain on Linux: every login you have saved, in one searchable window, with the passwords copied to the clipboard on request and the verification codes generated on the spot.
It can also write: a login you make on a site can be recorded in your real iCloud Keychain, and a password you change can be updated in place, so it reaches your other Apple devices.
The keychain is decrypted locally, into an encrypted vault whose key lives in your keyring. Nothing about it is sent anywhere but to Apple.
The first release: read the keychain, fill your logins, and record new ones.
